root_cause: The Netlify build restores index.html from the pinned compressed V18 payload in tools/bouw-v18-production-core.mjs before projecting the site-wide shell. Footer edits made only in repository HTML or a sibling after </footer> were therefore overwritten before production.
prevention_rule: Any customer-visible global footer contract must be projected in the pinned V18 production build path and mirrored in the canonical footer component, then verified by production HTML readback.

evidence.outcome: Production HTML readback after PR #3550 proved that repository footer edits alone did not survive the pinned V18 build path.
